description: G-1 contracts-only task: adds 27 P6A event types to EVENT_TYPE_REGISTRY in @projexlight/contracts plus cross-SDK types (AgentContext, CompletionRequest/Response, StreamChunk, CapabilityToken, ExecutionLogEntry, ToolManifest, TraceSpan/Timeline, MCP types). No HTTP surface — the 'endpoint' is a synthetic in-process registry mutation. Enforcement is the existing assertRegisteredEventType() guard plus the producer-side schema validator (OC-2 doctrine). METHOD CORRECTED (was POST): the endpoint is an internal:// pseudo-URL with no HTTP route, and skipReason said so, but declaring method=POST meant the test runner built a real HTTP request and dispatched it — reporting a failure for something the definition itself declares untestable. INTERNAL_FUNCTION is the method the runner skips, which is what testability:manual was always meant to express.
skipReason: Contracts-only update. No HTTP route exists. Verification is the existing CI lint (assertRegisteredEventType) plus type-check; both run via `pnpm -w build`.

testCases.name: Manual: verify event registry contains all P6A keys + types compile

errorCases.message: Unregistered event_type: <name>. Platform code must add it to EVENT_TYPE_REGISTRY; a tenant application registers its own types with POST /api/events/types using the convention <domain>.<entity>.<verb>.v<N>
errorCases.when: assertRegisteredEventType() (packages/contracts/src/events.ts:647-655) throws because the name is not a key of EVENT_TYPE_REGISTRY. This is the OC-2 guard every platform producer calls before emitting, and it is the failure mode a missed P6A registry entry actually produces — at the producer's call site, not here. The status is whatever the calling route maps an unhandled throw to; most SDK routes catch and return 500.

errorCases.message: event_type '<name>' does not follow the naming convention <domain>.<entity>.<verb>.v<N> (lowercase, e.g. capture.lead.created.v1). The .v<N> suffix is required so a later payload change can be a new version rather than a redefinition of rows already written.
errorCases.when: validateEventTypeName() (events.ts:625-633) rejects a P6A key added without the mandatory .v<N> suffix, with uppercase, or with a separator other than '-'/'_' inside a segment. Returned as a 400 by POST /api/events/types when an application registers a type; for a name added to the constant it fails the CI lint instead.
validateEventTypeName() is handed a non-string or an all-whitespace name — the empty-key case of a registry entry authored with a missing constant

a P6A cross-SDK type (AgentContext, CompletionRequest/Response, StreamChunk, CapabilityToken, ExecutionLogEntry, ToolManifest, TraceSpan/Timeline, MCP types) is added inconsistently with its consumers. Enforcement for this contracts-only task is compile-time, so the failure is a build error rather than an HTTP status — this row exists so QA does not go looking for a runtime one.
